viral_opportunities.snippet:
Author: @shavnyuyngah | Text: When I say Kerala has some of the very best documented residential architecture right now, this is exactly what I mean. Don’t skip the comments, the best views of this home are there.

House of Corridors treats hallways as the actual point of the house, not the boring bit between rooms. Instead of enclosed rooms connected by circulation, the whole 3,900 sq ft home unfolds through corridors that widen into pauses, bend around courtyards, and spill into verandas and s
viral_opportunities.author: @shavnyuyngah
viral_opportunities.summary: X post praising Kerala, India's contemporary residential architecture documentation, with strong visual comments thread.
viral_opportunities.engagement_angle: Weigh in on regional residential design excellence outside the US — draw parallel to LA villa typology's own attention to craft and site.

viral_reply.body: Corridors as the destination rather than the leftover space — that's a real idea, beautifully executed. The bends around the courtyards are doing the work of doors.
